black = pulp.LpVariable("black", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # black
green_tea = pulp.LpVariable("green_tea", lowBound=0, cat="Integer")  # green tea

# Objective: minimize total time
prob += 2 * black + 3 * green_tea

# Constraints
prob += 7 * black + 5 * green_tea <= 700  # has 700
prob += 15 * black + 18 * green_tea <= 700  # has 700
prob += green_tea - 4 * black >= 0  # green tea at least four black

prob.solve(pulp.getSolver("HiGHS", msg=False))
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[prob.status])
print("Objective:", pulp.value(prob.objective))
print("black =", pulp.value(black))
print("green_tea =", pulp.value(green_tea))
